name: workout-webapp
description: Single-page React app where an Athlete signs in, manages reusable workout routines, logs sessions and sets against them, browses workout history, and reviews per-exercise strength trends and personal records. Renders UI and calls workout-api for all persistence; holds no data of its own and performs no server-side logic.

dependencies.name: workout-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Workout Tracker API for routines, sessions, sets, exercises, progress trends, and the athlete's profile/unit preference.

dependencies.name: workout-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the Athlete in via Thunder SSO and issues the token the SPA attaches to API calls.
